request.style: English, gentle female solo voice with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, flute, strings, cello, solemn and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Cain knew his wife and gave birth to Enoch
He built a city and named it his son
From Enoch came Irad in the dust
Irad was the father of Mehujael

[Chorus]
Mehujael was the father of Methushael
Methushael was the father of Lamech
The line of Cain stood apart in the world
A lineage moving through the ancient earth

[Verse]
Lamech took two wives for himself
Adah was the first and Zillah the other
Adah gave birth to Jabal the elder
Father of tents and those who keep livestock

[Chorus]
Mehujael was the father of Methushael
Methushael was the father of Lamech
The line of Cain stood apart in the world
A lineage moving through the ancient earth

[Verse]
Jubal was the brother of Jabal
Father of all who play the lyre and pipe
Zillah gave birth to Tubal-Cain
He forged tools out of bronze and iron

[Bridge]
Tubal-Cain's sister was named Naamah
The civilization grew in their hands
Far from the godly line of Seth
Their names are written in the book of Genesis

[Outro]
Irad the father of Mehujael
Mehujael the father of Methushael
The descendants of Cain remain
